title: BoJ Summary of Opinions — September 17-18, 2026 MPM (no Outlook Report)
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its two year tables by this session. Against the header 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2026 September row parses exactly as ['Sept. 17 (Thurs.), 18 (Fri.)', '-', 'Oct. 1 (Thurs.)', 'Nov. 5 (Thurs.)'] — i.e. the Summary of Opinions of the September 2026 MPM publishes 2026-10-01, and that meeting carried NO Outlook Report (its column reads '-'). The same page states the release time verbatim: 'Summary of Opinions It will be released at 8:50 a.m.', which is 08:50 JST Thu 2026-10-01 = 19:50 EDT Wed 2026-09-30; corroborated from a released document's own embargo line, the prior-year analogue (Sept 18-19 2025 MPM) Summary PDF opening 'Not to be released until 8:50 a.m. Japan Standard Time on Tuesday, September 30, 2025.' Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the eleven BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
